subject: Culture
title: Diwali and Prosperity Gifts
description: A 60-second lesson on Diwali and Prosperity Gifts.

hook.text: During Diwali, Indian families exchange boxes of sweets so elaborate they rival wedding cakes.

buildup.text: Diwali celebrates the victory of light over darkness. Gifts invoke Lakshmi, goddess of wealth and fortune.

discovery.text: Corporate Diwali gifting is a billion-dollar industry. Companies send hampers to clients encoded with loyalty signals.

twist.text: Gold purchases spike during Diwali. Buying gold on this day is considered so auspicious that jewelers extend hours.

climax.text: Diwali gifting obligations can strain middle-class budgets. Social pressure turns celebration into financial stress.

punchline.text: Festival generosity has a price tag attached.

quiz.question: Which goddess is associated with Diwali prosperity gifts?
